repos.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repos.summary_zh: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的安全工作流自动化平台，融合可视化拖拽与自定义代码（JavaScript/Python），支持 400+ 集成和原生 AI 能力（基于 LangChain），提供自托管或云端部署选项，采用公平源代码许可，确保数据控制与可定制性。
repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
repos.summary_zh: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.summary_zh: free-for.dev 是一个面向开发者和运维人员的精选免费服务清单，涵盖 SaaS、PaaS、IaaS 等基础设施类工具。该列表聚焦于 DevOps 和系统管理员常用服务，强调长期可用的免费层级（非试用），并排除自托管软件。内容由社区协作维护，包含云管理、CI/CD、监控、安全等 30+ 个分类，帮助开发者快速发现并评估适合的免费资源。
repos.summary_en: free-for.dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS services tailored for developers and infrastructure teams. It focuses on tools useful for DevOps, sysadmins, and cloud engineers, excluding self-hosted software and limited-time trials. Maintained by a community of 1600+ contributors, it covers 30+ categories including cloud management, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and more, enabling informed decisions about free developer offerings.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
repos.summary_zh: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

repos.description: Delegate anything. It comes back done.
repos.summary_zh: Minds 是一款面向知识工作者的通用 AI 平台，支持在云、VPC、本地及隔离环境中灵活部署，让用户完全掌控基础设施、模型、权限与数据。它帮助创作者、策略师和运营人员自动化复杂的多步骤读写任务，并无需工程背景即可构建和部署内部 AI 工具（如应用、报告、分析等），实现真正可控的 AI 协作体验。
repos.summary_en: Minds is a general-purpose AI platform designed for knowledge workers—creators, strategists, and operators—offering full control over AI systems with flexible deployment across cloud, VPC, on-prem, and air-gapped environments. It enables users to automate complex multi-step read/write tasks and build, deploy internal AI tools (apps, reports, analyses) without engineering expertise, ensuring complete infrastructure, model, permission, and data control.

repos.description: General-purpose AI designed for knowledge workers — creators, strategists, and operators — and individuals seeking AI systems they can truly control to help them get work done, with full flexibility to extend and deploy anywhere (VPC, on-prem, or cloud).
repos.summary_zh: Minds Platform 是一个开源的人工智能基础平台，旨在为开发者、企业和个人提供可完全控制、扩展和随处部署的生产级AI系统。其核心包括 Anton 自动化代理和 Query Engine 语义搜索引擎，支持自动化任务执行、跨数据源智能检索与分析，适用于报表生成、企业知识库搜索、AI运营助手等场景，支持云、VPC、本地及混合部署。
repos.summary_en: Minds Platform is an open-source foundation for applied AI, enabling full control, extensibility, and deployment of production-ready AI systems anywhere—cloud, VPC, on-prem, or hybrid. It combines Anton, a self-improving automation agent, with the Query Engine for semantic search across structured and unstructured data, powering use cases like automated reporting, conversational BI, and enterprise AI assistants.

repos.description: Open Source Alternative to Vercel, Netlify and Heroku.
repos.summary_zh: Dokploy 是一款开源、可自托管的 PaaS 平台，旨在替代 Vercel、Netlify 和 Heroku。它极大简化了应用与数据库的部署管理，原生支持 Docker Compose 与多节点 Swarm 集群，集成 Traefik 实现自动路由，并提供实时监控、多服务器管理及丰富的通知功能。
repos.summary_en: Dokploy is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS platform designed as an alternative to Vercel, Netlify, and Heroku. It simplifies application and database deployment with native Docker Compose support, multi-node Swarm clustering, integrated Traefik routing, real-time monitoring, and comprehensive multi-server management.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持本地或云端部署，数据完全自主可控。内置日程管理、文档处理等技能，支持多智能体协作与自定义扩展，兼容多种聊天平台，易于安装与集成。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant that can be deployed locally or in the cloud, ensuring full data control. It features built-in skills like scheduling and document processing, supports multi-agent collaboration and extensible custom skills, and integrates with multiple chat platforms.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
repos.summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
repos.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: Self-hosted deployment platform
repos.summary_zh: Openship 是一款开源、可自托管的部署平台，内置 CI/CD 功能。它支持通过桌面应用、Web 面板或 CLI 推送代码、部署容器及管理基础设施，实现零配置文件的“一键式”应用交付。
repos.summary_en: Openship is an open-source, self-hostable deployment platform with built-in CI/CD. It enables push-to-deploy workflows, container management, and infrastructure control via desktop app, web dashboard, or CLI, requiring zero configuration files.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Ekko Studio 是一款本地优先的 AI 工作空间，支持多代理实时协作、可视化工作流构建与编码任务。集成 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理运行时，提供桌面端、Web 控制台与 Docker 部署方案，适用于开发者与团队的高效 AI 协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace supporting multi-agent collaboration, visual workflow building, and coding tasks. It integrates Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and other mainstream AI agent runtimes, offering desktop app, web console and Docker deployment options for developer and team efficiency.

repos.description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
repos.summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
repos.summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

repos.description: A modern self-hosted music player.
repos.summary_zh: Feishin 是一款现代化的自托管音乐播放器，支持 MPV 和 Web 播放器后端，提供现代化 UI、智能播放列表编辑、歌词同步与反同步功能，并支持将播放记录同步至服务器，适用于个人音乐库管理与流媒体播放。
repos.summary_en: Feishin is a modern self-hosted music player featuring MPV and web player backends, a sleek UI, smart playlist editing, synchronized lyrics, and playback scrobbling to your server, ideal for managing personal music libraries and streaming.

repos.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
repos.summary_zh: Octop 是腾讯开源的自托管多用户 AI 助手，采用多 Agent 架构支持团队协作与个人使用。集成专家库、RAG 知识库、MCP/OAuth 连接器生态，支持 MBTI 人格模板、IDE 集成与浏览器自动化，JWT 隔离保障数据隐私本地化运行。
repos.summary_en: Octop is Tencent's open-source self-hosted multi-user AI assistant featuring a multi-agent architecture for team and personal collaboration. Integrates expert libraries, RAG knowledge base, MCP/OAuth connectors, MBTI personas, IDE integration and browser automation, with JWT isolation ensuring local privacy.

repos.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Web UI 是一个功能完整的 Hermes Agent 管理仪表盘，支持多平台 AI 聊天会话管理、实时消息流、定时任务调度、使用量分析与成本追踪，以及 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等八种通信渠道的统一配置，提供本地 SQLite 会话存储与全局搜索能力。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Web UI is a full-featured dashboard for managing the Hermes Agent, offering multi-platform AI chat session control, real-time streaming, scheduled cron jobs, usage analytics with cost tracking, and unified configuration for 8 communication channels including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

repos.description: Self-hosted AI gateway for multi-channel, multi-credential setups — API keys and subscription accounts, scheduling, failover, request logs and usage. 自托管 AI 网关：多渠道多凭据统一接入，含密钥与订阅账号、调度容错、日志与用量。
repos.summary_zh: GPT-Load 是一个高性能企业级 AI API 透明代理服务，专为需要集成多 AI 服务的开发者和企业设计。基于 Go 构建，具备智能密钥轮询、负载均衡、故障自动恢复、动态配置热重载等特性，支持 OpenAI、Google Gemini、Anthropic Claude 等多种 AI 服务格式，提供完整的监控和管理界面。
repos.summary_en: GPT-Load is a high-performance, enterprise-grade transparent proxy service for AI APIs, designed for developers and enterprises integrating multiple AI services. Built with Go, it features intelligent key rotation, load balancing, automatic failure recovery, hot-reload configuration, and comprehensive monitoring. Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude APIs with a Vue 3 management interface.

repos.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
repos.summary_zh: AIHOT 是一个开源的行业热点监测框架，自动从多源采集资讯，经大模型预筛、双评分与去重聚簇，生成中文标题、摘要与日报/周报/月报，支持 RSS、X、微信公众号等信源，可快速部署为法律、金融、HR 等垂直领域的智能热点站。
repos.summary_en: AIHOT is an open-source framework for industry-specific news aggregation. It auto-collects from RSS, web, X and WeChat, applies AI pre-filtering, dual scoring and event clustering, then generates Chinese headlines, summaries and daily/weekly/monthly reports. Deployable as a vertical hotspot dashboard for legal, financial, HR domains.

repos.description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
repos.summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
repos.summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

repos.description: ezBookkeeping is an open source, powerful, self-hosted personal finance app that is easy to use.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.description: Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
repos.summary_zh: Bento 是一款单文件演示文稿工具，将编辑器、查看器和动画引擎全部封装在一个约 560KB 的 HTML 文件中。它采用纯 JSON 数据结构，实现本地优先、离线可用，支持端到端加密的实时协作与 AI 智能体直接编辑，是 PowerPoint 的轻量级、无云端依赖的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Bento is a single-file presentation tool that packs an editor, viewer, and animation engine into a ~560KB HTML file. Utilizing a pure JSON data structure, it offers local-first, offline capabilities with E2EE real-time collaboration and native AI agent editing, serving as a lightweight, cloud-free alternative to PowerPoint.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.description: Browser-native Office / PDF / CAD / archive viewer for internal web apps, with Vue, React, Svelte, jQuery, Web Components, and no server-side conversion.
repos.summary_zh: Flyfish File Viewer 是一款纯前端文件预览组件，支持 Office、PDF、CAD、压缩包等 208 种格式。它利用浏览器原生解析与渲染技术，无需后端转换，确保数据隐私与安全。支持 Vue、React 等主流框架，具备按需加载和私有化部署能力，适用于企业内部系统。
repos.summary_en: Flyfish File Viewer is a browser-native file preview component supporting 208 formats including Office, PDF, CAD, and archives. It leverages client-side parsing and rendering without server-side conversion, ensuring data privacy. Compatible with Vue, React, and other frameworks, it offers lazy loading and private deployment for enterprise internal systems.

repos.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects 的免费多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时监控、离线告警，到期通知，历史数据查看、延迟追踪、地图展示等功能。兼容主流Linux系统，Alpine Linux，OpenWrt，macOS，群晖 DSM、飞牛 fnOS、Windows系统。
repos.summary_zh: CF-Server-Monitor 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时追踪 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等指标，提供历史图表、全球地图展示、离线告警及 WebSocket 实时推送。兼容 Linux、Alpine、OpenWrt 和 Windows 系统，集成 JWT 认证与 Turnstile 人机验证，通过 GitHub Actions 实现一键部署，适合运维自动化与多节点监控场景。
repos.summary_en: CF-Server-Monitor is a multi-server monitoring probe system built on Cloudflare Workers and D1, offering real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics with historical charts, global map visualization, offline alerts, and WebSocket-based live updates. Compatible with Linux, Alpine, OpenWrt, and Windows, it integrates JWT authentication and Turnflare Turnstile verification, enabling one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for efficient operations automation and multi-node monitoring.

repos.description: MacOS语音输入法，实时识别、大模型文本优化、全本地存储
repos.summary_zh: Type4Me 是一款 macOS 语音输入工具，支持本地/云端双引擎识别、大模型文本优化及全本地存储。基于 SherpaOnnx 实现设备端离线语音识别，无需 API Key；集成火山引擎等云端服务，提供实时流式识别与多模态 Prompt 处理。支持自定义快捷键、热词管理、片段替换及 CSV 导出，兼顾隐私性与扩展性。
repos.summary_en: Type4Me is a macOS voice input tool featuring dual local/cloud ASR engines, LLM-powered text optimization, and full local storage. Powered by SherpaOnnx for offline on-device recognition without API keys, it integrates cloud services like Volcengine for real-time streaming and advanced prompt processing. Includes customizable hotkeys, vocabulary management, clipboard context support, and CSV export, balancing privacy with extensibility.

repos.description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
repos.summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
repos.summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

repos.description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

repos.description: 完全运行于 Cloudflare Worker的现代聊天系统：实时通信、Telegram 双向桥接、消息与文件加密 A modern, self-hosted team chat built on Cloudflare — realtime messaging, Telegram bridge, encrypted messages & files, and WebMCP. |
repos.summary_zh: EdgeChat 是基于 Cloudflare 全家桶构建的零运维团队聊天系统，支持公开/私有群组、私信与实时消息通信。特色功能为 Telegram 双向消息桥接，Bot 驱动跨平台无缝同步。前端采用 Vue 3 + Hono，Durable Objects 承载 WebSocket 连接，AES-256-GCM 加密保障数据安全，在免费额度内即可落地企业级 IM。
repos.summary_en: EdgeChat is a zero-infrastructure team chat system built on Cloudflare ecosystem, supporting public/private groups, DMs, and real-time messaging. Its standout feature is bidirectional Telegram bridge via Bot for seamless cross-platform sync. Powered by Vue 3 + Hono frontend, Durable Objects for WebSocket, and AES-256-GCM encryption, it delivers enterprise-grade IM within Cloudflare's free tier.

repos.description: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
repos.summary_zh: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款开源的网站目录导航系统，支持一键部署个人导航站点。内置基于 Playwright/Jina/OpenAI 的自动网站收录功能，集成 SEO 优化、多语言国际化、暗黑/亮色主题切换，并提供 MinIO/AWS S3/腾讯云 COS 多种图片存储方案，适合快速搭建个性化网站导航平台。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is an open-source website directory/navigation system enabling one-click deployment of personal navigation sites. It features automatic site crawling via Playwright/Jina/OpenAI, integrated SEO optimization, multilingual i18n, dark/light theme toggle, and multiple image storage options including MinIO, AWS S3, and Tencent Cloud COS — ideal for quickly building personalized navigation platforms.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: Python项目自动化多服务器部署的工具
repos.summary_zh: essay 是一个基于 Fabric 的 Python 项目自动化部署工具，支持多服务器打包与部署。它通过标准化流程简化开发到生产环境的交付，集成 PyPI 服务器和 Git 仓库，提供快速构建、版本化打包、虚拟环境管理及 Supervisord 进程控制，适用于需高效扩展的 Python 服务场景。
repos.summary_en: Essay is a Python project automation deployment tool based on Fabric, supporting multi-server packaging and deployment. It streamlines the development-to-production pipeline with standardized workflows, integrating PyPI servers and Git repositories. It enables rapid builds, versioned packaging, virtual environment management, and Supervisord process control, ideal for scalable Python service deployments.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: Django project template layout
repos.summary_zh: django-layout 是一个基于最佳实践的 Django 项目模板，提供开箱即用的现代化开发体验。集成 uv 依赖管理、ruff/prettier 代码规范、goodconf 环境配置、结构化日志、TailwindCSS 样式方案、pytest 测试框架及 mypy 类型检查，支持 Docker 部署，显著提升 Django 项目初始化效率与生产环境健壮性。
repos.summary_en: django-layout is a modern Django project template offering sane defaults based on best practices. It integrates uv for dependency management, ruff/prettier for linting, goodconf for config, structured logging, TailwindCSS, pytest with coverage, mypy for type safety, and production-ready settings via Docker, streamlining Django project setup and deployment.

repos.description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
repos.summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
repos.summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.summary_zh: 一个轻量级 VPN 配置生成工具，通过一条命令在 VPS 上自动生成支持 Reality 协议的节点配置，并输出二维码供 OneXray、Shadowrocket、Clash Meta 等主流客户端扫码一键导入，免去手动配置的繁琐流程。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight VPN config generator that creates Reality protocol-compatible node configurations via a single command. Outputs QR codes for seamless one-click import into popular clients like OneXray, Shadowrocket, and Clash Meta, eliminating manual setup.

repos.description: Self-hosted short link and live QR platform with ownership, review, branded QR codes, analytics, and an auditable path to AI-assisted operations.
repos.summary_zh: AI Shortlink 是一个自托管的短链与活码管理平台，强调链接传播后的可控性。核心功能包括短链管理、多策略活码运营、品牌二维码生成及团队协作审核。采用 Go 单体架构与 SQLite 部署，支持 Docker 一键启动，并规划了基于大模型的 AI 辅助运营演进路线。
repos.summary_en: AI Shortlink is a self-hosted short link and live QR platform emphasizing post-distribution control. It offers short link management, multi-strategy live QR operations, branded QR code generation, and team collaboration with audits. Built as a monolithic Go service with SQLite, it supports Docker deployment and outlines a roadmap for AI-assisted operations.

repos.description: Yet another django based blog created in May 2015
repos.summary_zh: MayBlog 是一个基于 Django 和 Bootstrap 开发的博客系统，于2015年5月创建。支持多用户、多角色、Markdown 写作、SEO 优化，并通过 Docker 实现容器化部署。提供 RESTful API（开发中）和后台管理界面，采用微服务架构设计，适合个人或团队搭建内容管理平台。
repos.summary_en: MayBlog is a Django and Bootstrap-based blog system created in May 2015. It supports multi-user, multi-role access, Markdown writing, SEO optimization, and containerized deployment via Docker. Features include RESTful API (in development), admin interface, and modular deployment configurations, ideal for personal or team content management.

repos.description: A carefully curated list of awesome OpenClaw resources — not everything, just the best.  Skills · Plugins · MCP · Tools · Deployments · Security · Research · Alternatives。精心策划的 OpenClaw 优质资源大合集 —— 不求大而全，只求真有用。
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一个精心策划的优质资源合集，聚焦于本地优先、自主运行的 AI 智能体框架。涵盖技能插件、MCP集成、部署方案、安全实践及替代工具，旨在提供实用而非泛化的技术指南，帮助用户快速构建和运行自主 AI 代理。
repos.summary_en: Awesome OpenClaw is a meticulously curated collection of top-tier resources for the OpenClaw autonomous AI agent framework. It covers skills, plugins, MCP integrations, deployments, security, and alternatives, focusing on practicality over exhaustiveness to empower developers in building local-first, self-hosted AI agents.

repos.description: 文科生也会配的微信个人号后台，Content based wechat massive platform framework, what you need to do is only adding your articles in :)
repos.summary_zh: MyPlatform 是一个专为非技术用户设计的微信个人号内容管理平台，支持通过添加文章快速搭建微信公众号。基于 Python 开发，部署于新浪云（SAE），完全免费且配置简单，文科生也可在20分钟内完成搭建，实现内容分发与互动功能。
repos.summary_en: MyPlatform is a content-based WeChat personal account backend framework designed for non-technical users. Built with Python and hosted on SAE, it enables quick setup by adding articles, allowing anyone to create a functional WeChat content platform in under 20 minutes with zero cost.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: A self-hosted MCP relay for native coding runtimes
repos.summary_zh: Agenvo是一个自托管的MCP中继服务，将ChatGPT、Grok Bot等AI助手与运行在本地电脑和服务器的编码代理（如Codex、Herdr）无缝连接。用户可通过AI助手跨设备统一调度、监控和续接编码任务，无需开放入站端口，支持Agent自行重连恢复工作。
repos.summary_en: Agenvo is a self-hosted MCP relay that bridges AI assistants (ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse) with native coding runtimes (Codex, Herdr) on your computers and servers. It enables cross-device agent coordination via WSS connections without inbound ports, letting AI assistants monitor, manage, and resume coding tasks seamlessly.

repos.description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
repos.summary_zh: 面向VibeCoding的Codex工程Skill，将产品设计与架构规范转化为可部署的全栈项目。采用pnpm monorepo架构，支持多Agent协同规则、AI审查、质量门禁与CI/CD流水线，Routine模式高效处理日常修复，Init模式负责标准化初始化。
repos.summary_en: A Codex engineering skill for VibeCoding that transforms product designs into deployable full-stack projects using pnpm monorepo. Supports multi-agent rules, AI review, quality gates, and CI/CD pipelines, with Routine mode for efficient daily fixes and Init mode for standardized project setup.

repos.description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
repos.summary_zh: 面向 AI 辅助开发的工程 Skill，帮助 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 将产品设计与架构方案转化为可部署的全栈项目。支持 pnpm monorepo、多 Agent 协作规则、强制 AI 审查、可执行质量门禁、CI 流水线及容器化部署资产，覆盖初始化、日常开发、仓库审计与发布准备等完整生命周期。
repos.summary_en: An engineering skill for AI-assisted development that helps Codex, Claude Code, and compatible agents transform product designs and architecture briefs into deployable full-stack projects. Supports pnpm monorepo, multi-agent collaboration rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI pipelines, and container deployment assets across initialization, daily development, audits, and release workflows.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.
